title: Core System
description: Four reference-dependent images establishing a reusable frontier base visual system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the reusable Frontier Base anchor. Images 02-04 preserve the habitat module proportions, airlock language, utility pipe routing, and survival-first lighting hierarchy while changing scene context and deliverable emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
